mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('ISSUED', 'CHECKED_IN')) AS issued_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CHECKED_IN') AS checked_in_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ISSUED') AS not_checked_in_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('CANCELED', 'INVALIDATED')) AS canceled_count FROM issued_tickets WHERE expo_id = #{expoId}

SELECT h.id AS id, h.issued_ticket_id AS issued_ticket_id, it.ticket_code AS ticket_code, h.method AS method, h.result AS result, h.checked_at AS checked_at, h.processed_by_client_id AS processed_by_client_id, h.detail AS detail FROM check_in_histories h JOIN issued_tickets it ON it.id = h.issued_ticket_id WHERE h.expo_id = #{expoId} ORDER BY h.checked_at DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
